title: Steve Jobs Introduces the Macintosh
summary: Recording of the January 1984 Boston Computer Society meeting where Steve Jobs unveiled the Macintosh. It is followed by a panel Q&A with core Mac team members such as Andy Hertzfeld, Bill Atkinson and Steve Capps.
why: HN points to it as the primary source for the original Mac demo and the personal post-show Q&A with the team.

quote.text: The post-show is my favorite part[0]. It's just so personal. Almost feels like a meetup!
